verdict.rationale: Antigravity's docs explicitly describe natural-language operation across editor, CLI, and agent surfaces ('Edit, orchestrate, and build all in natural language', 'natural language code commands', voice-to-prompt transcription), and community reports (comm-1, comm-10) confirm hands-on use of the CLI/IDE for prompted agentic tasks. Missing for 10: no independent benchmark of NL command accuracy/robustness, and some community reports describe harness/quality issues (comm-8) that add minor uncertainty about consistency.
